## UX checklist (only if this changes user-facing behavior — see PLAN.md §4)

- [ ] Discoverable without reading anything
- [ ] Responds in < 100 ms to the intention
- [ ] Has empty, loading, error, and stale states where relevant
- [ ] Undoable where relevant (⌘Z)
- [ ] Works with keyboard
- [ ] Works with VoiceOver
- [ ] Respects Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit `Altillo.xcodeproj` or other generated/local files (`build/`, `Config/Local.xcconfig`, etc.)
- [ ] I ran `xcodegen generate` after changing `project.yml` and it produced no unexpected diffs
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
